name: Salons and spas

seo.title: Google Maps Management for Salon Chains | SAAYT
seo.description: Fresh photos per branch · Eid and season hours and fast replies to client reviews on Google for every salon location from one dashboard

h1: Your salon shines in every branch on Google
lead: Clients choose a salon from photos and reviews and demand peaks before Eid. SAAYT keeps every branch ready with fresh photos, correct hours and quick replies

pains.d: Old or few photos send clients to another salon
Extended hours before Eid and quick changes must be right in every branch
Reviews about a stylist or service need a warm respectful reply

helps.d: Reminders for branches with outdated photos
Pre-Eid hours for every branch in one edit
Warm replies in your salon’s voice

example.review: Noura did my colour and it came out even better than I imagined
example.reply: Thank you so much and we are delighted you love your colour. We have passed your kind words to Noura and hope to see you again soon at our Narjis branch
example.note: A warm reply in the salon’s voice

faq.q: Can replies sound warm and personal?
faq.a: Yes. Set your salon’s tone and favourite phrases and SAAYT follows them
It reminds you which branches have outdated photos and you can upload for every branch from one place
